posts.text: It's 3 in the morning and I can't sleep even though the baby can. Does anyone else go through this? I feel very alone.

posts.author: Circle promotora
posts.transcript: Hi, mama. I'm here with you. This happens to many of us. If you can, rest when the baby rests, and ask someone to keep you company for a little while. You are doing well.

posts.text: Today I drank a hot tea sitting down, with no rush. Small, but it did me good.

tips.title: Go slowly
tips.text: Your body did something huge. Rest when you can and accept help without guilt.

tips.title: Get comfortable
tips.text: Find a quiet place, with a cushion and a glass of water nearby. Ask your promotora or your clinic if you have questions.

tips.title: Ask for a hand
tips.text: Talk to a friend, relative or neighbor you trust to look after your kids while you go to your appointment.
